title: Disney+ US Creative Asset
description: Creative assets accepted by Disney+ (With Ads) in the United States. Sources: Disney Advertising 'DISNEY+ VIDEO AD — Video Ad Formats' canonical US spec PDF (© 2023, last update 2026-03-05) and the US 'Video Commercial' product page (products.disneyadvertising.com/video-commercial/), retrieved 2026-08-20. Only linear video commercials in long-form content breaks are covered; interactive/pause/shoppable formats are unverified and intentionally not accepted.

video.title: Video track
video.description: Exactly one video track; constant frame rate only; progressive scan; no frame-rate conversion (no 3:2 pulldown added for broadcast).

h264Profile.description: H.264 Main Profile @ Main Level (MP@ML); listed as a standalone spec bullet.

bitrateKbps.description: Constant bitrate (CBR) 10-40 Mbps. ProRes is variable by design (waived); H.264/ProRes beyond the range can be accepted.

programmaticBitrate.title: Programmatic bitrate tier
programmaticBitrate.description: Bitrate guidance for programmatic-served creatives (optional; only when serving programmatically).

sdVariant.title: SD variant
sdVariant.description: Standard-definition variant (optional; only when delivering SD).

aspectRatio.description: 4:3 or 16:9 pixel aspect ratio; 3:2 display aspect ratio is not accepted.

frameRate.description: 23.98, 24, 25, or 29.97 or 30 fps based on native frame rate.

audio.title: Audio track
audio.description: Audio is required; exactly one track matching the video duration.

trackCount.description: Must have exactly one audio track.

codec.description: Advanced Audio Coding (AAC) or Pulse-code modulation (PCM).

bitDepth.description: 16- or 24-bit depth (PCM codec only; omit for AAC).

matchesVideoDuration.description: Audio track must match the video duration.

vastVersions.description: VAST 2.0 & 3.0 per the canonical US PDF.
vastVersions.$comment: Conflict recorded (finding U1): the canonical PDF says 'VAST 2.0 & 3.0'; the product page's Hulu-scoped serving text says 'VAST 2.0 only'. This schema encodes the canonical PDF.

assetType.description: Linear video creative in Disney+/Hulu long-form content commercial breaks.

durationSeconds.$comment: The canonical US PDF lists 'Duration • 15, 30, 45, 60, 75, or 90 seconds'. The product page publishes no duration numbers; Disney's Oct 2023 press corroborates ':15s to :90s'. The Türkçe/EN EMEA editions differ (5-120 range / 15-20-30-60 list).

aspectRatio.description: Required aspect ratio 16:9; 1:1 or 9:16 videos will be rejected.

servingPath.description: Serving path; drives the file-weight cap.

fileWeightGB.description: Max file weight: 1.9 GB for partner/VAST/programmatic-served; 250 MB for Hulu-served (see conditional below).

clickableCTAStylingAllowed.description: CTA buttons that look clickable ('Learn More', 'Buy Now') are not allowed.

qrCodesAccepted.description: QR codes are accepted; all QR codes are subject to review.

leadersAllowed.description: No leaders such as slates, countdowns, etc.

letterboxing.description: Letterboxing (black bars top/bottom) when native aspect ratio is 1.78:1, 2.35:1, or 1.33:1 is not allowed; pillarboxing (side bars) is not allowed; an exception will be considered for a creative reason (contact your Disney representative).
letterboxing.$comment: The US rule differs from the EMEA English edition (case-by-case) and the Türkçe edition (not accepted at all).

turnaroundBusinessDays.description: Up to 5 business days from receipt of the final assets.

safetyZonePublished.description: The product page references 'Safety Zones' only via imagery; no numeric pixel values are published in visible text (finding U2). Keep the spec's safety-zone guidance from the canonical PDF imagery.
safetyZonePublished.$comment: No numeric safety-zone value is encoded because none is published in retrievable text; do not use the EMEA 220x135 value for US creatives.
